name: Percona Server for MySQL
tagline: A drop-in MySQL build that ships enterprise features (thread pool, audit, encryption) as free GPL code.
description: Percona Server for MySQL is Percona's enhanced, fully compatible build of MySQL Community Server. It tracks upstream LTS releases and adds the features Oracle reserves for MySQL Enterprise Edition, including a thread pool, audit logging, PAM/LDAP authentication, data masking, Vault-backed keyring encryption and extra instrumentation, all under GPLv2. Since 8.x Percona releases only for MySQL LTS lines (8.4 and 9.7), which makes it a conservative choice for teams that want MySQL behavior with enterprise operability but no license fees. It pairs with Percona XtraBackup, Toolkit and the Percona Operator for Kubernetes.

pricing.notes: Software is free; Percona sells support, managed services and consulting.

scale.notes: Same topology options as MySQL: async/semi-sync replicas, Group Replication, or Vitess/ProxySQL for sharding.

strengths: MySQL Enterprise-style features (thread pool, audit log, LDAP auth, data masking) at no cost
Binary-compatible drop-in for MySQL Community of the same version
Extra diagnostics: user/table statistics, slow-log extensions
Percona Operator gives a supported Kubernetes deployment path
Long-term support aligned with MySQL LTS lines
weaknesses: Releases lag upstream MySQL by weeks to months
Skips MySQL Innovation releases, so new features arrive only with LTS
Not offered as a managed service by the big clouds (use RDS MySQL or Percona's own services)
useCases: Self-hosted MySQL fleets needing enterprise security features
Replacing MySQL Enterprise Edition to cut license cost
High-concurrency OLTP needing a thread pool
MySQL on Kubernetes via the Percona Operator
notIdealFor: Teams wanting the newest MySQL Innovation features immediately
